name: MIT OpenCourseWare (+ MIT Learn)

ai_features.name: MIT Learn / AskTIM
ai_features.what: AI recommendation assistant over 12,700+ MIT learning resources; summarises course structure

ai_features.name: AI assistant / AI tutor in select offerings
ai_features.what: lecture Q&A, flashcards, summaries; tutor guides problem sets without giving answers (select biology courses); model/vendor not stated

note: No usage numbers or learning-impact evidence published for the AI features. Course count: 500 at 2003 launch, 1,800+ by 2007 (about page).

name: Coursera (merged with Udemy 2026-05-11)

ai_features.name: Coursera Coach
ai_features.what: in-course generative-AI tutor: concept explanation, practice, mastery-based guidance

ai_features.name: Coach Dialogues / Role Play / Course Builder / AI grading
ai_features.what: instructor-embedded Coach; role-play practice with Coach as counterpart; AI-assisted content creation (vendor press release names Coach, Role Play, Course Builder; detail counts unverified)

scale.source: secondary web summaries only; primary not located

evidence.design: vendor-reported users vs non-users comparison (design not published)
evidence.finding: users completed 11.6% more course items per hour; 90% satisfaction (Coursera-reported, Nov 2025 secondary). Quiz pass +9.5% first attempt appears only in secondary summaries
16.7% more course completions within a day of peer review; grading within 1 minute; ~45x more feedback - from search summary, NOT confirmed in the earnings release

business.value: $2.5 billion; 0.800 Coursera share per Udemy share; completed 2026-05-11

privacy_note: Coach powered by third-party LLMs (Google Gemini reported in secondary source); data terms not reviewed (unverified)
note: Registered-learner and revenue figures verified from company releases; all AI-impact numbers are vendor claims and only partly traced to a primary document. Registered learners are cumulative sign-ups, not active users.

name: edX (2U)

ai_features.name: edX Xpert
ai_features.what: ChatGPT-API learning assistant: explains concepts, answers follow-ups, recommends modules, quizzes, summarises lectures, support

ai_features.name: edX plugin for ChatGPT
ai_features.what: course discovery from within ChatGPT Plus

business.value: 2024-07-25; debt cut by >50% to ~$459M; ~$110M new capital; emerged private in Sept 2024

note: No usage or impact data located for Xpert after launch; edX's trajectory is dominated by 2U's financial distress. Open edX (separate open-source LMS) is covered in stream C.

name: Harvard CS50 (CS50x on edX; CS50.ai duck)

ai_features.name: CS50 Duck (cs50.ai)
ai_features.what: GPT-based tutor with guardrails (no direct solutions), Ed forum bot, VS Code explainers

evidence.study: Liu et al. 2024, Teaching CS50 with AI (SIGCSE)
evidence.design: descriptive deployment + student survey; no control group
evidence.finding: 75% used the tools frequently and 94% found them helpful (self-report); authors are the course team

evidence.study: Liu et al. 2025, Improving AI in CS50
evidence.design: iterative evaluation with human feedback on duck responses
evidence.finding: reports usage logs and quality improvements; authors are the course team

privacy_note: Uses OpenAI models via API per course docs (unverified)
note: Best-documented MOOC-scale AI tutor deployment; evidence is descriptive and developer-authored.

name: Harvard Physical Sciences 2 AI tutor (PS2 Pal)

ai_features.name: PS2 Pal
ai_features.what: custom GPT-4-based tutor with expert-written solutions, pedagogy-guided prompts

evidence.study: Kestin, Miller et al. 2025, Scientific Reports
evidence.design: crossover RCT, AI tutor at home vs in-class active learning, one semester
evidence.finding: median learning gains more than double with AI tutor, in less time, higher engagement/motivation; single course, short term, tutor built by the study team

note: Included because it is the strongest controlled evidence from an OCW/MOOC-adjacent elite university; the authors designed the tutor, so not independent of the intervention.
